entities.summary: Denise Coates is a British businesswoman. She is the founder, majority shareholder and joint chief executive of online gambling company, bet365. She is one of the highest paid executives in the UK and the highest paid female executive. In December 2024, Coates' estimated net worth was £9.5 billion.
